nodes.label: discord_gateway_loop()
nodes.description: Run a single Discord Gateway WebSocket session.

nodes.label: fetch_token()
nodes.description: Fetch or refresh the tenant_access_token. Standalone function so it can be shared between FeishuChannel methods and listener threads.

nodes.label: add_reaction()
nodes.description: Add the `Status_PrivateMessage` acknowledgment reaction to a message. Best-effort: failures are logged but do not interrupt message forwarding.

nodes.label: download_resource()
nodes.description: Download a resource (image/file) from Feishu API to local disk. Saves to: ~/.MoontonClaudeDesktop/cache/feishu_downloads/{message_id}/{file_name}

nodes.label: build_card_content()
nodes.description: Build a Feishu interactive card as a JSON string. Feishu API expects `content` to be a stringified JSON value.

nodes.label: extract_heading()
nodes.description: Extract heading text from a Markdown heading line (e.g. "## Foo" → "Foo"). Returns None if the line is not a heading.

nodes.label: is_code_fence()
nodes.description: Check if a line is a code fence (opening or closing). Opening: ```lang  or  ``` Closing: ```

nodes.label: adapt_markdown_for_feishu()
nodes.description: Adapt standard Markdown to Feishu card-compatible markdown. - Converts headings to bold (Feishu card markdown doesn't render # headings) - Preserves code blocks untouched

nodes.label: split_markdown_chunks()
nodes.description: Split markdown text into chunks at paragraph boundaries (double newlines), each chunk staying within `max_chunk_size` characters. Respects code block boundaries — never splits inside a code fence. Truncates with a note if total card size would exceed CARD_MAX_SIZE.

nodes.label: find_event_listener_script()
nodes.description: Locate the event-listener.cjs script.  Priority: 1. Bundled resources (production) 2. Relative path from exe working directory (development)

nodes.label: sleep_with_shutdown()
nodes.description: Sleep in small increments, checking shutdown flag.

nodes.label: bot_feishu_token()
nodes.description: Helper: get Feishu credentials for a bot and fetch (or reuse cached) access token.

nodes.label: Channel
nodes.description: Trait implemented by each platform channel (Telegram, Discord, Feishu).
